files.content:
schema_version = "1.4"
artifacts = ["/workspace/release", "/srv/origin.git"]

[task]
name = "peter/release-branch-rescue"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Recover lost release commits from reflog, integrate offline upstream changes, and restore tracked main branch."
keywords = ["git", "reflog", "branch-rescue", "git-recovery", "ops"]
[[task.authors]]
name = "Peter Makhnatch"

[metadata]
category = "git-operations"
difficulty = "medium"
capability = "recover unreferenced commits via reflog, integrate divergent history, and configure branch tracking"

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 120.0
collect = []
environment_mode = "separate"

[verifier.env]

[agent]
network_mode = "no-network"
timeout_sec = 600.0

[environment]
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 600.0
os = "linux"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 1024
mcp_servers = []

[environment.env]

[solution.env]

rationale: library crack sweep 2026-10-12: hardened setup = separate verifier + agent egress off (agent-network-none@1)
